src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Shared save group
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Lets a whole request's changes and its retry record save together or not at all.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Main database connection
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: The app's single door to the database, defining every kind of record and how farms are kept apart.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Database tooling setup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Lets database change tools connect, and refuses to unless told explicitly which database to use.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Business record list
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Lists which records count as a farm's business data, so each module's records are covered by the same rules.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Business record ordering
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Puts business record types in a fixed order so they are always handled the same way.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Audit log record settings
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Sets how audit log entries, the history of who changed what, are stored.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Current save group
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Small holder that gives code access to the database save group currently in progress.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Current user
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Remembers who is acting during a request, for access checks and the audit log.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Flock access limit
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Records which flocks the current person may see for this request, and refuses changes once set.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Duplicate request record
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Stores a claim and the saved answer for each write request so a retry does not do the work twice.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Farm stamp on saves
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Stamps every new record with its farm and blocks any save that would touch another farm's data.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Platform business records
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Lists the shared records that belong to the platform rather than a module, such as audit and retry records.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: No-retry guard
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Marks work that must run only once, so a database retry cannot repeat it.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Bad farm ID error
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: The error raised when a record's farm ID is not the expected plain ID type.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Current farm
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Remembers which farm the current request belongs to, and refuses to be changed once set.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Farm switch error
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: The error raised when something tries to change the farm of a request already assigned.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Wrong-farm save error
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: The error raised when a save would write a record belonging to a different farm.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Save changes
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Saves everything a task changed to the database in one step.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Repositorie.name: Audit log writer
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Repositorie.description: Adds an entry to the audit log in the same save as the change it records.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Repositorie.name: Plain-text search
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Repositorie.description: Treats what someone types in a name search as plain text, so special characters do not change the search.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Repositorie.name: Lookup shape tags
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Repositorie.description: Tags database lookups with the shape they promise, such as one grouped read per page, so tests can check it.
